function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book confirmed salon appointment. Only call after explicit caller confirmation of exact service and time. customerPhone: E.164 only, e.g. +15555550123. Strip spaces/dashes/dots/parens, add +1 for 10-digit US. Never send "+155 555 50123".

service.description: Service ID from salon policy, e.g. cut_and_style, color_consultation, blowout.

startDateTime.description: Confirmed local start, ISO-8601 with explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-26T10:00:00-07:00.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for interpretation, must be America/Los_Angeles for this demo salon.

customerName.description: Caller full name, min 2 chars, e.g. Jamie Example.

customerPhone.description: Caller phone in E.164 only, e.g. +15555550123. Strip spaces/dashes/dots/parens, add +1 for 10-digit US numbers. Never send formatted numbers like +155 555 50123.
